consumers.reason: Electron RunAsNode, the diagnostics Worker, Profile patches, icons, and generated command shims require ordinary filesystem paths.
Agent preset and skill scanners consume ordinary filesystem paths outside Electron's ASAR-aware module loader.
ClientModuleRegistry uses CommonJS package resolution for every dsh.client package and the web server reads its ./client bundle from that resolved path.
Cordis typert-loader resolves every contributor's ./typert Host manifest from the physical package tree.
Profile package operations execute pnpm's bundled CLI from an ordinary filesystem path.
Electron Builder marks native modules and executable assets that cannot run directly from ASAR.
